assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable scheme offers rent-to-own homes with payments guaranteed never above a quarter of income, and none reaches the Main KPI of 500,000,000 households. Indonesia's state bank BTN launched a rent-to-own scheme in 2022 for low-income and informal workers, but a 2025 benchmark against Malaysia finds low awareness, weak regulatory support and limited uptake (https://doi.org/10.17358/brcs.6.2.319). Shared-equity and community land trust models are documented with outcome studies (https://doi.org/10.1186/s12889-024-20982-z, https://doi.org/10.1080/19491247.2024.2367830), and a 2025 NBER paper examines returns in affordable housing finance (https://doi.org/10.3386/w33470), but none guarantees a payment-to-income cap at scale. UN-Habitat projects 3 billion people will need adequate housing by 2030 (https://unhabitat.org/topic/housing). Honest limit: lease-purchase, shared equity, community land trusts and income-linked payment rules are known designs, so tasks that restate them are not new work; the unsolved part is financing the gap between 25% of low and informal incomes and the cost of a home while managing default and title risk, so tasks must target a checkable new piece such as an underwriting or risk-pooling method validated on data. Habitat for Humanity's homeownership page returned 404, so its payment rule is not relied on.

additionalSearches.query: rent-to-own lease purchase affordable housing low income evaluation (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 1,737 works: an Indonesia-Malaysia rent-to-own benchmark (2025), NBER 'An Alpha in Affordable Housing?' (2025), Egypt and Myanmar low-income strategies. Rent-to-own exists in pilots without an income cap guarantee.

additionalSearches.query: shared equity homeownership community land trust affordability outcomes (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 708 works: shared-equity homeowner health trajectories (2025), community land trust frameworks (Memphis, Toronto, Australia). Known models, local scale.

additionalSearches.query: housing affordability 30 percent income rule rent burden global (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 1,625 works on affordability burdens (Greece, Croatia, US rental gap) and a 2025 study of affordability for Habitat for Humanity clients. No scheme found guaranteeing payments at or below 25% of income at scale.

additionalSearches.query: Habitat for Humanity homeowner mortgage payment percent of income affordability (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 31 works: local affordable-housing plans and a study defining affordability for Habitat clients; no evidence of a global or large-scale 25%-of-income rent-to-own programme.

BTN introduced rent-to-own in 2022 for low-income households and informal workers; the study finds low awareness, weak regulation, minimal stakeholder engagement and limited uptake, and recommends feasibility analysis.
